legal_text: Section 115 concerns voluntarily causing hurt. The applicable definition, exceptions, and punishment must be checked against the relevant subsections of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023.
explanation: This provision deals with voluntarily causing hurt or grievous hurt to another person. The exact punishment depends on the circumstances and the applicable part of the provision.
keywords: hurt, injury, grievous hurt, physical assault, physical injury

legal_text: Whoever threatens another with injury to his person, reputation or property, or to the person or reputation of anyone in whom that person is interested, with intent to cause alarm to that person, or to cause that person to do any act which he is not legally bound to do, or to omit to do any act which that person is legally entitled to do, commits criminal intimidation.
explanation: This provision concerns threats intended to cause alarm or to force a person to do or not do something. The circumstances and nature of the threat matter when determining applicability.
keywords: threat, threatening, criminal intimidation, alarm, threat message, harassment

legal_text: Whoever, by deceiving any person, fraudulently or dishonestly induces the person so deceived to deliver any property to any person, or to consent that any person shall retain any property, or intentionally induces the person so deceived to do or omit to do anything which he would not do or omit if he were not so deceived, and which act or omission causes or is likely to cause damage or harm to that person in body, mind, reputation or property, is said to cheat.
explanation: This provision concerns deception that causes a person to deliver property or act or refrain from acting in a way that causes or may cause legally relevant harm.
keywords: cheating, fraud, deception, scam, online fraud, money fraud, dishonest inducement

legal_text: Whoever, intending to take dishonestly any movable property out of the possession of any person without that person's consent, moves that property in order to such taking, is said to commit theft.
explanation: This provision concerns dishonest taking of movable property from another person's possession without consent.
keywords: theft, stolen, stealing, stolen property, stealing belongings, robbery

legal_text: Whoever, by words either spoken or intended to be read, or by signs or by visible representations, makes or publishes any imputation concerning any person intending to harm, or knowing or having reason to believe that such imputation will harm, the reputation of such person, is said, except in the cases hereinafter excepted, to defame that person.
explanation: This provision concerns imputations made or published with the required intention or knowledge of harming another person's reputation, subject to statutory exceptions.
keywords: defamation, reputation, false statement, defamatory statement, reputation damage

legal_text: Any man who watches, or captures the image of a woman engaging in a private act in circumstances where she would usually have the expectation of not being observed either by the perpetrator or by any other person at the behest of the perpetrator, or disseminates such image, shall be punished in accordance with this section.
explanation: This provision addresses specified acts involving watching, capturing or disseminating images of a woman engaged in a private act, subject to the conditions in the section.
keywords: voyeurism, private image, intimate image, recording, hidden camera, image sharing

legal_text: Any man who follows a woman and contacts, or attempts to contact, such woman repeatedly so as to foster personal interaction repeatedly despite a clear indication of disinterest by such woman, or monitors the use by a woman of the internet, e-mail or any other form of electronic communication, commits the offence of stalking.
explanation: This provision addresses specified repeated following, contact despite clear disinterest, and certain forms of monitoring of a woman's electronic communication.
keywords: stalking, repeated messages, following, online stalking, monitoring, harassment

legal_text: A man committing any of the acts specified in this section, including unwelcome and explicit sexual overtures, demands or requests for sexual favours, showing pornography against the will of a woman, or making sexually coloured remarks, commits the offence of sexual harassment.
explanation: This provision covers specified forms of sexual harassment against a woman, subject to the acts and conditions described in the section.
keywords: sexual harassment, unwanted sexual messages, sexual remarks, sexual request, pornography

legal_text: Whoever, fraudulently or dishonestly make use of the electronic signature, password or any other unique identification feature of any other person, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to three years and shall also be liable to fine.
explanation: This provision concerns fraudulent or dishonest use of another person's electronic signature, password or other unique identification feature.
keywords: identity theft, password theft, hacked account, stolen credentials, cybercrime

section_title: Punishment for cheating by personation by using computer resource
legal_text: Whoever, by means of any communication device or computer resource cheats by personation, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to three years and shall also be liable to fine.
explanation: This provision concerns cheating by personation when a communication device or computer resource is used.
keywords: online scam, cyber fraud, impersonation, fake account, online cheating, phishing
